AnswerWord.description: A word a page offers for an experiment's analysis being elsewhere, and what it does.
AnswerWord.title: AnswerWord

ElsewhereRow.description:
A person's answer that an experiment's analysis is elsewhere: the page's magenta flag
(magenta: "a person said so").

actor.description: Who said so, under the machine's decider name.
actor.title: Actor

read_by_run.description: Whether this run read the answer; only then is the experiment off the list of no analysis found.
read_by_run.title: Read By Run

said.description: The words a page shows beside the flag.
said.title: Said

said_now.description: Whether the answer is in force in the Record now; differs from read_by_run while a change waits for the next re-run.
said_now.title: Said Now

ElsewhereRow.title: ElsewhereRow

ExperimentCompleteness.description: One experiment, as the engine found it: a folder an experiment rule classed.

analysed_elsewhere.description: What a person said of its analysis being elsewhere; null where nobody did.

analysis_files.description: Files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) at an analysis stage.
analysis_files.title: Analysis Files

answer_target.description: The Record target an answer about its analysis being elsewhere is written to, through POST /api/review/answer with a word of answer_words.
answer_target.title: Answer Target

date.description: Its date, as the themes view dates it: the earliest date a name in its folder gives, else the earliest believed time of a file in it; null where nothing dates it (unknown, never a guess). Given whether or not themes are computed.
date.title: Date

derived_files.description: Files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) derived from its raw acquisitions, wherever they lie.
derived_files.title: Derived Files

files.description: Files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
files.title: Files

folder.description: The experiment's folder, relative to its root.
folder.title: Folder

has_analysis.description: Whether the analysis files or results tables found in it count as an analysis of its own, under the completeness settings in force.
has_analysis.title: Has Analysis

name.description: The folder's own name, as written.
name.title: Name

name_parts.description: The folder's name read into parts by the tokenizer; empty where not read.
name_parts.title: Name Parts

name_read.description: Whether the run recorded a layout for the name; false: no parts are given.
name_read.title: Name Read

person.description: Whose experiment it is: the first folder level below its root, until a setting naming a person replaces it; null for a root's own folder.
person.title: Person

raw_acquisitions.description: Raw acquisition files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
raw_acquisitions.title: Raw Acquisitions

raw_followed.description: Raw acquisitions found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) that are followed by an analysis file found.
raw_followed.title: Raw Followed

result_tables.description: Results tables found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in its folder.
result_tables.title: Result Tables

said.description: One sentence a page shows for it, in plain words.
said.title: Said

share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.description: The share of its raw acquisitions found that are followed by an analysis file found; null where no raw acquisition was found (unknown, never 0).
share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.title: Share Of Raw Followed By Analysis

shown_name.description: The name a row shows: the folder's name with the dates the tokenizer read in it left out; the name itself where the run recorded no layout to read.
shown_name.title: Shown Name

theme.description: Its theme, where themes are computed; null where none is given.
theme.title: Theme

theme_label.description: The words of its theme (its label), beside the theme's number, for a page to show; null where it has no theme or themes are not computed.
theme_label.title: Theme Label

ExperimentCompleteness.title: ExperimentCompleteness

GroupRow.description: One person's or one theme's experiments, summed over their raw acquisitions found.

analysed_elsewhere.description: Experiments a person said are analyzed elsewhere, as this run read them.
analysed_elsewhere.title: Analysed Elsewhere

analysis_files.description: Analysis files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists).
analysis_files.title: Analysis Files

experiments_with_raw.description: Experiments with at least one raw acquisition found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists).
experiments_with_raw.title: Experiments With Raw

no_analysis_found.description: Experiments listed as having no analysis found in what was read.
no_analysis_found.title: No Analysis Found

raw_acquisitions.description: Raw acquisitions found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists).
raw_acquisitions.title: Raw Acquisitions

raw_followed.description: Raw acquisitions found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) followed by an analysis file found.
raw_followed.title: Raw Followed

result_tables.description: Results tables found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists).
result_tables.title: Result Tables

share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.description: Followed over found, pooled; null where no raw acquisition was found.
share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.title: Share Of Raw Followed By Analysis

GroupRow.title: GroupRow

NamePartItem.description: One part of an experiment folder's name, as the tokenizer read it.

hidden.description: Whether the shown name leaves the part out (a date).
hidden.title: Hidden

kind.description: What the tokenizer read it as: word, date, clock, number, quantity, version, indexed or identifier. A number inside a date or a clock is read as that.
kind.title: Kind

sense.description: The kind of the sense the Dictionary bound the part to (reagent, technique and so on), or null where it bound none.
sense.title: Sense

text.description: The part as the name writes it.
text.title: Text

NamePartItem.title: NamePartItem

OutsideRow.description: Files the engine found in no experiment it found, and the raw data among them.

files.description: Files found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in no experiment found.
files.title: Files

raw_acquisitions.description: Raw acquisitions found by the engine in what was read (not every file that exists) in no experiment found.
raw_acquisitions.title: Raw Acquisitions

raw_followed.description: Of those, the ones followed by an analysis file found.
raw_followed.title: Raw Followed

share_of_raw_followed_by_analysis.title: Share Of Raw Followed By Analysis

OutsideRow.title: OutsideRow

Thresholds.description: The completeness settings the response was computed under (``completeness.*``).
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

description: Per experiment, per person and per theme: raw data and analysis, as the engine found them.

themes_computed.description: Whether themes were computed; where not, per-theme sums are empty.
themes_computed.title: Themes Computed

title: CompletenessResponse
